componentLibrary.name: Phylonco
componentLibrary.description: PhyloSpec components provided by the beast-phylonco package (single-cell genotype and read-count models).

types.name: ReadCount
types.description: Nucleotide read counts (A, C, G, T) for every cell and site, e.g. loaded from an mpileup file

generators.name: fromMpileup
generators.description: Loads nucleotide read counts from an mpileup file; names gives the cell (taxon) name of each sample column, in order

arguments.name: file
arguments.description: Path to the mpileup file

arguments.name: names
arguments.description: Cell names, one per sample column of the mpileup file

generators.name: taxa
generators.description: Returns the taxa (cells) of read-count data

arguments.name: readCounts
arguments.description: Read-count data

generators.name: numTaxa
generators.description: Returns the number of cells in read-count data

arguments.name: readCounts
arguments.description: Read-count data

generators.name: numSites
generators.description: Returns the number of sites in read-count data

arguments.name: readCounts
arguments.description: Read-count data

generators.name: gt10
generators.description: GT10 model of unphased diploid genotypes (10 states) with GTR-like nucleotide exchangeabilities

arguments.name: relativeRates
arguments.description: Relative nucleotide substitution rates in AC, AG, AT, CG, CT, GT order

arguments.name: genotypeFrequencies
arguments.description: Equilibrium frequencies of the 10 unphased genotypes

generators.name: ReadCountModel
generators.description: Read counts of single cells evolving on a tree: unphased genotypes evolve under qMatrix (e.g. gt10) and are observed through sequencing error, allelic dropout, a negative-binomial coverage model and Dirichlet-multinomial allele counts. Genotypes, ploidy and coverage are integrated out.

arguments.name: tree
arguments.description: Cell phylogeny

arguments.name: qMatrix
arguments.description: Genotype substitution model, e.g. gt10

arguments.name: sequencingError
arguments.description: Sequencing error probability (epsilon)

arguments.name: allelicDropout
arguments.description: Allelic dropout probability (delta)

arguments.name: meanAllelicCoverage
arguments.description: Mean coverage of a single allele (t)

arguments.name: allelicCoverageVariance
arguments.description: Variance of the coverage of a single allele (v)

arguments.name: cellSizeFactors
arguments.description: Size factor of every cell (s)

arguments.name: homozygousOverdispersion
arguments.description: Dirichlet-multinomial concentration for homozygous or single-allele read counts (w1). At fixed read depth, larger values give less overdispersion.

arguments.name: heterozygousOverdispersion
arguments.description: Dirichlet-multinomial concentration for heterozygous read counts when both alleles are retained (w2). At fixed read depth, larger values give less overdispersion.

generators.name: Ploidy
generators.description: Number of alleles retained (1 or 2) in every cell at every site, after allelic dropout. As in LPhy's Ploidy; the BEAST 3 engine integrates it out inside the read-count likelihood.

arguments.name: numCells
arguments.description: Number of cells (n in LPhy)

arguments.name: numSites
arguments.description: Number of sites (l in LPhy)

arguments.name: allelicDropout
arguments.description: Probability that one allele of a cell drops out at a site (delta)

generators.name: CoverageModel
generators.description: Read depth of every cell at every site: negative binomial with mean t * s * ploidy and variance from v. As in LPhy's CoverageModel; the BEAST 3 engine integrates it out inside the read-count likelihood.

arguments.name: ploidy
arguments.description: Retained alleles per cell and site, drawn from Ploidy (alpha in LPhy)

arguments.name: meanAllelicCoverage
arguments.description: Mean coverage of a single allele (t)

arguments.name: allelicCoverageVariance
arguments.description: Variance of the coverage of a single allele (v)

arguments.name: cellSizeFactors
arguments.description: Size factor of every cell (s)

generators.name: ReadCountModel
generators.description: Read counts given the genotypes, ploidy and coverage of every cell and site: Dirichlet-multinomial allele counts with sequencing error. As in LPhy's ReadCountModel. When genotypes, ploidy and coverage are used only here, the BEAST 3 engine integrates them out, giving the same likelihood as the compact ReadCountModel(tree, qMatrix, ...).

arguments.name: genotypes
arguments.description: Unphased genotype alignment, drawn from PhyloCTMC with a genotype qMatrix such as gt10 (D in LPhy)

arguments.name: ploidy
arguments.description: Retained alleles per cell and site, drawn from Ploidy (alpha in LPhy)

arguments.name: coverage
arguments.description: Read depth per cell and site, drawn from CoverageModel

arguments.name: sequencingError
arguments.description: Sequencing error probability (epsilon)

arguments.name: homozygousOverdispersion
arguments.description: Dirichlet-multinomial concentration for homozygous or single-allele read counts (w1). At fixed read depth, larger values give less overdispersion.

arguments.name: heterozygousOverdispersion
arguments.description: Dirichlet-multinomial concentration for heterozygous read counts when both alleles are retained (w2). At fixed read depth, larger values give less overdispersion.
